description: Issue-title normalisation: gives an opened issue the title prefix of its category. `categories` names the repository's category file, a JSON object with the component categories under `product_categories` and the categories without components under `generic_forms`; both are lists, a missing one counts as empty, and together they hold at least one item. An item of `generic_forms` is an object with `key` (the name of the category, unique across both lists), `title_prefix` (the prefix that an issue of the category gets) and `labels` (the labels of which one on an issue makes it an issue of the category). An item of `product_categories` is an object with `key`, `title_prefix` and `labels` as well, and with `source_directory` (the folder, relative to the repository root, whose direct subfolders are the components), `marker` (the file in a component's folder that makes it a component; it starts with `key: value` lines between two `---` lines), `dynamic_title_prefix` (the prefix of an issue about a component, with `{component}` for the component's name), `component_label` (the heading of the component field in the issue form) and `required_metadata` (the keys that every marker must hold). Each value is a non-empty string, except `labels` and `required_metadata`, which are lists of non-empty strings and may be empty; every key is required, and a key that is not named here is ignored. Invented example of the setting: {"categories": "intake/categories.json"}. Invented example of the category file: {"product_categories": [{"key": "tool", "source_directory": "tools", "marker": "TOOL.md", "title_prefix": "[tool]", "dynamic_title_prefix": "[{component}]", "component_label": "Tool", "required_metadata": ["name"], "labels": ["category:tool"]}], "generic_forms": [{"key": "question", "title_prefix": "[question]", "labels": ["category:question"]}]}.
